### [Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed](https://openai.com/index/previewing-ultrafast)

**OpenAI** · 2026-08-13

OpenAI introduced Ultrafast, a new API service tier powered by Cerebras that runs the GPT-5.6 Sol model at speeds up to 14 times faster than standard execution.

- Delivers generation speeds of up to 750 output tokens per second.
- Runs specifically on Cerebras hardware infrastructure.
- Executes the GPT-5.6 Sol model up to 14× faster.

**Why it matters:** Developers using the OpenAI API can significantly lower latency for real-time applications by utilizing high-throughput Cerebras hardware.

### [llm-gemini 0.33](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/13/llm-gemini/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-13

Version 0.33 of the llm-gemini plugin adds support for new Gemini models, compatibility with LLM 0.32, reasoning traces, and server-side tool execution.

- Adds support for gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, and embedding models gemini-embedding-2 and gemini-embedding-001.
- Upgraded for LLM 0.32 compatibility, enabling visible reasoning traces and server-side tool flags like '-T CodeExecution'.
- Gemini 3.7 Flash supports high, medium, and low thinking efforts, but removes the minimal thinking option available in 3.6 Flash.

**Why it matters:** Users can now access Google's latest Gemini models, reasoning traces, and server-side code execution directly through the LLM CLI interface.

`gemini` `llm` `python` `ai` `cli`
